title.name: HeliaLux
title.sub: The Juwel HeliaLux SmartControl in Home Assistant: every channel as a slider, real transitions, profiles, clouds and a sun cycle. It holds the colour you set. No cloud.

new.title: True to the profile
new.text: Before the first point of a profile the value of that point applies, exactly as on the lamp, instead of a wrongly extrapolated one.

new.title: Safe profile names
new.text: Names with characters the lamp cannot store are rejected before saving, so a profile on the lamp is never mangled.

new.title: Wind in any unit
new.text: Clouds from weather convert knots and feet per second correctly. Holding the state starts only once, even for two quick polls.

new.title: Calendar versions
new.text: Year, month and the release of that month: 26.10.2 is the second release of October 2026. The jump from 1.0.1 is intended, updates show up as usual.

features.title: Every channel a slider
features.text: White, blue, green and red from 0 to 100 %, right on the device page, plus the service set_channels.

features.title: An RGBW light with transitions
features.text: Brightness keeps the mix, transition fades in gentle steps, switching on brings back the last mix instead of 100 % white.

features.title: Holds what you set
features.text: After a power cut or lamp restart the colour comes back by itself, the manual colour simulation is extended before it runs out.

features.title: No fight with the app
features.text: Changes in the Juwel app are taken over. Start the daytime simulation and Home Assistant steps back.

features.title: Profiles and weekly plan
features.text: Read and write whole profiles with get_profile and set_profile, one profile for all days or one per weekday.

features.title: Clouds, sun and weather
features.text: Cloud strength and motion, a cloud window, clouds from a weather entity and a sun cycle that follows sunrise and sunset.

features.title: Acclimatization
features.text: A new tank starts dimmed (10 to 100 %) and reaches full brightness after 1 to 12 weeks.

features.title: Robust, with diagnostics
features.text: One request at a time, lost commands repeated, unavailable only after three misses. Clock offset repair issue and a diagnostics download.

entities.title: Light
entities.text: light.trigon_190_light: RGBW with absolute channel values (0 to 255 = 0 to 100 %), brightness and transition.

entities.title: Channel numbers
entities.text: white, blue, green and red from 0 to 100 %, plus the durations of the colour and daytime simulation.

entities.title: Switches
entities.text: manual_color_simulation, manual_daytime_simulation, keep_manual, sun_cycle, acclimatization and weather_clouds.

entities.title: Selects and times
entities.text: profil, profile_monday to _sunday, cloud_intensity and cloud_motion. cloud_from, cloud_to, sun_earliest and sun_latest.

entities.title: Sensors
entities.text: Channel values in %, current_profile with the attributes curve, profile_now and week, device_time and profiles.

entities.title: Diagnostics
entities.text: reachable with the last error, clock_offset and color_simulation_remaining.

items.title: statusvars.js
items.text: Channels, mode and the lamp clock, every 15 seconds over the lamp's own web server.

items.title: POST /stat
items.text: Channels, colour and daytime simulation, one request after the other.

items.title: /pedit and /week.html
items.text: Profile points, clouds and the weekly plan, saved permanently in the lamp.
